title: Sales entry, integration context and financial derivation

mechanisms.title: Dynamic Product Proposal
mechanisms.memory_hook: A proposal helps the user choose products; it is not yet an order item.
mechanisms.question: Which products should SAP propose for this customer and business context before normal item checks run?

inputs.name: product proposal procedure and access sequence
proposal sources such as order history, listing/exclusion, item proposal and customer-material records

mechanisms.determination: The product-proposal procedure searches configured data sources in order and builds a customer-specific proposal list. The proposal is an entry aid; normal sales checks such as pricing, ATP, incompletion, material determination and free-goods determination run after an item is accepted and quantity is entered.

failure_modes.prove: Check customer/document procedure determination → proposal procedure → access/source sequence → source data availability.

failure_modes.symptom: Proposal shows a product but order checks fail after selection
failure_modes.prove: Separate proposal generation from normal item processing; trace listing, material determination, item category, pricing and ATP after quantity entry.

tests.setup: Configure order history and an item proposal as two proposal sources for one customer.
tests.assert: The proposal follows the configured source sequence and normal sales checks begin only after a proposed item is accepted with quantity.

mechanisms.title: Cross-Selling Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Product proposal starts with the customer. Cross-selling starts with the product.
mechanisms.question: Which additional products should be suggested because this material is in the order?
mechanisms.determination: Cross-selling uses condition-technique-based rules to find additional products for the material or product context already entered in the sales order.

failure_modes.prove: Check trigger material → cross-selling profile → condition-technique access → valid condition record.

failure_modes.symptom: Suggestions are confused with customer product proposal
failure_modes.prove: Identify the trigger: customer/sales area means product proposal; entered material means cross-selling.

tests.setup: Maintain a cross-selling relation for one trigger material and leave a similar material without a record.
tests.assert: Suggested products appear only for the configured trigger context.

mechanisms.title: Inbound B2B Sales Context Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Before an inbound purchase order becomes a sales order, SAP must decide which commercial world it belongs to.
mechanisms.question: Which sales area, sales document type and payment-term tolerance should be used for this inbound B2B message?

inputs.name: standard assignment or flexible determination rules

mechanisms.determination: For supported B2B order services, SAP can use standard customer/supplier assignments or evaluate a wider set of inbound fields to determine sales area, sales document type and discrepancy allowance for payment terms.
controls: commercial interpretation of external purchase orders
configuration_surfaces: Flexible determination rules for inbound B2B

failure_modes.symptom: Inbound order reaches S/4HANA but creates the wrong order type or sales area
failure_modes.prove: Trace message fields → standard/flexible context rule → determined sales area/document type before debugging SD item logic.

failure_modes.symptom: Correct payload fails only for one buyer/supplier relationship
failure_modes.prove: Compare identifiers and rule match against a working inbound message before changing sales configuration.

tests.setup: Send two controlled B2B messages that differ in one field used by flexible context determination.
tests.assert: The configured rule selects the expected sales area, document type, or tolerance for each message.

mechanisms.title: Profit Center Derivation
mechanisms.memory_hook: Revenue account says where to post. Profit center says whose performance it belongs to.
mechanisms.question: Which profit center should the sales item carry into the financial process chain?

inputs.name: flexible sales determination dimensions where supported

mechanisms.determination: In standard derivation, a sales-order item commonly inherits the profit center from the product. In supported flexible scenarios, additional sales dimensions can participate. Once derived, the value should remain consistent through follow-on financial processing.
outputs: profit center on sales item and financial context
controls: financial consistency across sales and billing

failure_modes.symptom: Correct revenue account but wrong profit center
failure_modes.prove: Separate G/L account determination from profit-center derivation; trace controlling object, product, and flexible-rule source.

failure_modes.symptom: Profit center changes unexpectedly later in the chain
failure_modes.prove: Compare the original sales-item derivation with follow-on document inheritance before introducing FI substitution.

tests.setup: Create sales items with controlled products or account-assignment contexts that carry different profit-center sources.
tests.assert: The sales item receives the expected profit center and downstream documents preserve the intended context.
